verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Signifyd can ingest outcome events, including chargebacks and representment outcomes. It also shows merchants can cancel guarantees. Nothing documents that analyst review decisions or confirmed fraud outcomes are fed back to retrain the model or tune Decision Center rules. Recording outcome events is an adjacent data-ingestion capability, not evidence that the system learns from each worked case.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, my review decisions and confirmed fraud outcomes feed back into the model and rules, so the system learns from every case we work
